text: SFTP and FTPS are frequently confused. What is the relationship?
choices: SFTP is a subsystem of SSH on port 22; FTPS is FTP wrapped in TLS — unrelated protocols with similar names
FTPS is the successor to SFTP
explanation: This is why port 22 appears twice in the port table. Knowing the relationship prevents both firewall misconfiguration and a common interview stumble.
